purpose: Teach: 国名/軽自動車/預ける/最大手/料率/概論/役務/全日空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、国名表記の規定を社内で作られたぞ
lines.en: When you were starting out, you set company standards for how we'd refer to our partner countries.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recollection. Slight pause before each detail—pulling up a memory with care. Warm but serious. The tone of someone who watched and learned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に軽自動車を貸与された
lines.en: I did. And I remember how you handled that—lending company cars to the staff, no hesitation.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. A slight nod in the voice. Not defensive, but grounded—this is fact. Gentle pride underneath, held close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お得意様の物を預ける時、責任を持たれたぞ
lines.en: You took real responsibility when clients left things in our care. That mattered to you.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. Each phrase settles. The voice of someone reflecting on a principle that shaped everything after. Warm, almost tender.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界最大手として誇りを持たれた
lines.en: You did. And I carried that with me—the pride of being the best in our field, knowing what that meant.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to himself. Slight breath before 'pride'—the weight of it. Respectful pause between thoughts. Voice carries both inheritance and responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、保険料率の交渉に強かったぞ
lines.en: You never backed down in insurance negotiations. You held the line.
lines.style: Admiring, crisp. A note of quiet astonishment—still marveling at the skill. Slight emphasis on 'never' and 'held.' Not boastful, just clear-eyed respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営概論を新人に直接教えられた
lines.en: That's what I tried to do—pass on what you taught me. Training new people in business fundamentals, the way you did it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. The voice of someone still learning from those lessons. Connecting the dots between then and now. Soft conviction—not proving anything, just continuing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、役務契約の責任を明確にされたぞ
lines.en: You made the terms clear. Service contracts meant something because you stood behind every word.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis. Lingering on 'clear' and 'every word.' The tone of someone who understands that precision was an act of integrity. Solemn, slightly distant—remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは全日空便で世界各地を巡回された
lines.en: And I learned to see the whole picture the way you did—traveling for ANA, visiting clients everywhere, understanding the world we were building.
lines.style: Quiet closure. Slower pace, settling into acceptance. A gentle wisdom in the delivery—not final, but complete. The voice of someone who has lived the lesson and passed it forward.
